notices.format: Written notice of the right to revoke; the statute prescribes no wording, type size or form
notices.support: The statute gives **no wording, type size or form** for that notice
notices.summary_row: Door-to-door sale: five business day revoke right and written notice
notices.hold_reason: no prescribed wording; the statute only lists required content

notices.title: Notice of Potential Claims Must Be Provided within One Year (separate signed page attached to the contract)
notices.trigger: Contract to design, construct or remodel a dwelling (single-family house, duplex or multi-family unit); remodel means a change worth more than 25 percent of the structure's value
notices.format: Separate page attached to the contract, titled at the top, conspicuous, signed by the purchaser
notices.support: must be included on a separate page attached to the contract and must contain a title at the top of the page that reads
notices.summary_row: Defect notice on a separate signed page attached to the contract (dwelling design, construction or remodel)

changes.new: Five business days, written notice of the right (AS 45.02.350, official text; the statute gives no wording); federal also applies
changes.support: within five business days of entering into the contract

changes.new: Five business days from entering into the contract; the statute does not define business day. The buyer revokes by tendering the goods back or by registered letter marked Deliver to Addressee Only, Return Receipt.
changes.support: upon the posting of a registered letter, marked Deliver to Addressee Only, Return Receipt, of rejection

changes.new: Certificate of Registration with bond and insurance (general $25,000 bond; specialty $10,000; residential $20,000 with endorsement; one project of $10,000 or less $5,000), AS 08.18; name, mailing address and principal address on every contract and ad, registration number on contracts and ads (AS 08.18.051)
changes.support: Advertising and contracts must also include the contractor's registration number.

changes.new: AS 45.45.920 is a free-trial law only, not an automatic renewal law; it prints nothing in an ordinary cleaning plan unless a free trial is offered
changes.support: It is not an automatic renewal law and prints nothing in an ordinary cleaning plan unless a free trial is offered.

unsure: AK-defect-notice: the builder cannot tell whether a job is a dwelling or a remodel worth more than 25 percent of the structure, so the page is stored on file instead of printed.
AK-cancel: the statute requires a written notice of the five business day right but prescribes no sentence, so nothing is loaded.
